name: Data Analyzer: A valid Excel workbook loads into a table with correct headings and values
objective: Shows an .xlsx file is read correctly, including column names, size and individual cell values.
precondition: Offline test harness; a small made-up Excel workbook is built in memory.

steps.data: 3 made-up rows (1/Alice/25, 2/Bob/30, 3/Charlie/35) with headings id, name, age
steps.expected: Columns id, name, age; 3 rows by 3 columns; first name is Alice and last age is 35

name: Data Analyzer: An Excel file read the way the upload screen reads it loads correctly
objective: Shows the exact route the web page uses for uploaded Excel files (read the bytes, then load) works.
precondition: Offline test harness; a small made-up Excel workbook is built in memory.

steps.action: Read the bytes from an in-memory stand-in for an uploaded file and load them
steps.data: 2 made-up rows with headings patient_id, age
steps.expected: 2 rows by 2 columns with headings patient_id and age

name: Data Analyzer: The general load function handles Excel when told the format is xlsx
objective: Shows the general loader passes xlsx content to the Excel reader.
precondition: Offline test harness; a small made-up Excel workbook is built in memory.

steps.action: Call the general loader with format xlsx

name: Data Analyzer: Excel numbers stay numbers and text stays text
objective: Shows values are not altered when read from Excel.
precondition: Offline test harness; a small made-up Excel workbook is built in memory.

steps.action: Load the workbook and read back each column
steps.data: product_id 1,2; price 19.99,29.99; product_name Widget A, Widget B (made-up)
steps.expected: Values come back exactly as entered: whole numbers, decimal prices and text names

name: Data Analyzer: A zero-byte Excel upload is rejected with a clear error
objective: Shows an empty file produces a readable "Failed to load Excel" error rather than a crash.
precondition: Offline test harness; no workbook is built.

steps.action: Load an empty byte sequence as Excel
steps.expected: A value error is raised whose message contains 'Failed to load Excel'

name: Data Analyzer: A file that is not really Excel is rejected with a clear error
objective: Shows non-Excel content is refused with a readable error.
precondition: Offline test harness; no workbook is built.

steps.action: Load text bytes that are not a workbook
steps.data: The bytes of the sentence 'this is not a real xlsx file'
steps.expected: A value error is raised whose message contains 'Failed to load Excel'

name: Data Analyzer: An Excel file with only a header row gives an empty table with the right columns
objective: Shows a workbook with headings but no data is accepted, not treated as an error.
precondition: Offline test harness; a small made-up Excel workbook is built in memory.

steps.action: Load a workbook that has only headings
steps.data: Headings col1, col2, col3 and no data rows
steps.expected: Columns col1, col2, col3 and 0 rows; no error

name: Data Analyzer: A totally empty Excel sheet loads without crashing
objective: Shows a workbook with nothing at all in it returns an empty table rather than an error.
precondition: Offline test harness; a small made-up Excel workbook is built in memory.

steps.action: Load a workbook with no headings and no rows
steps.expected: A data table with 0 rows is returned; no error (the column list is not checked)
